title: Playback observation and desktop persistence
scope: Fresh synthetic project in the explicitly selected instrumented desktop runtime. Human playback judgment and automated persistence are separate observations.
steps: Confirm the prepared Golden project and Main timeline are open. Keep the project structure unchanged.

Play the first four seconds: observe the visible test pattern and listen for the synthetic tone. Pause and scrub if helpful. Record visible playback problems, missing audio or apparent synchronization issues; this is not a calibrated latency measurement.
Stop playback. Record Pass, Fail or Blocked with what you actually observed and your hands-on time. An agent may transcribe your finding but must not invent a human signoff.

Choose Continue only when you are finished using the project. Automation will verify the timeline, save, quit through the normal app menu, reopen the same project in a fresh process, and verify its contents again.
postcondition: Main and Secondary retain their prepared clip identities, source ranges, timing and track structure through desktop Save, native Quit and Reopen.
